card: This pull request eliminates avoidable test timeouts and unnecessary fixture setup to shorten test execution times. It bounds negative timeout checks in p2p_node_network_limited and interface_ipc_mining to at most five seconds, honors configured single-epoch runs in the wallet descriptor benchmark, and switches two wallet unit tests away from 100-block chain setup fixtures. According to the author, the timeout reductions alone save roughly eight minutes of cumulative CI worker time on affected jobs. No dependencies are noted.
changed_since_previous: The previous evaluation lacked the diff; the actual patch confirms the four discrete changes in test waits, fixtures, and benchmark configuration with no additional changes.
evidence: Author description: 'The timeout changes alone save approximately eight minutes of accumulated test-worker time on CI jobs running both transports and IPC mining.'

Author description: 'in p2p_node_network_limited replace the expected sync timeout with header/ping barriers and a bounded negative check. At CI timeout factor 40, saves roughly 195 seconds per transport.'
Author description: 'in interface_ipc_mining cap three expected no-event waits at five seconds, saving roughly 105 seconds at factor 40 in CI.'
problem: CI and local test runners spend substantial time waiting on negative timeouts—checks for events that should not happen—scaled by large timeout factors (up to 40x), as well as constructing unused chain state. This unnecessarily inflates CI run times and developer turnaround.

risk.why: Mistakes could cause test flakiness or false positives in functional tests or benchmarks, affecting CI and developers.

summary: Removes unnecessary waits, timeouts, and fixture setup overhead across two functional tests, two wallet unit tests, and one benchmark. In particular, it replaces a scaled negative sync timeout with synchronization barriers and a capped negative assertion in p2p_node_network_limited, limits negative event waits to five seconds in interface_ipc_mining, honors single-epoch sanity runs in the wallet loading benchmark, and avoids mining 100 blocks in wallet tests that do not require chain state.
